CarTV is a lightweight M3U / M3U8 playlist tool, built for watching on the road.

SCREEN MIRRORING
- Put your whole iPhone screen on the car display: works with any app, even ones without a Cast button
- Open any app and it shows up on the car screen exactly as on your phone
- One tap on the Cast to Car tab to start

WHAT IT DOES
All you need is an M3U or M3U8 link. CarTV parses it, sorts the entries into the groups defined in your playlist, and plays them. No account, no sign-in, nothing to configure.

FORMATS AND PLAYBACK
- M3U and M3U8 playlists
- HLS and standard HTTP streams
- Hardware-accelerated decoding, with a software decoder as fallback for MKV, HEVC and DTS
- Embedded and external subtitles, including tracks extracted from MKV
- Reads tvg-logo and group-title tags from your playlist
- Remembers where you left off

YOUR OWN MEDIA SERVER
- Connect to your own Jellyfin or Emby server
- Browse your libraries, seasons and episodes
- Episodes are sorted automatically and resume where you stopped
- Server addresses and credentials never leave your device

CAR MODE
A landscape layout made for a phone in a dashboard mount: oversized controls, large type, and one-tap switching between entries. Built for passengers.
Note: for passenger use only. Never watch while driving.

MOMENTS WORTH STOPPING FOR
Park by the lake on a quiet weekend, set up your fishing rod, and finally watch that old movie you've been saving. At the campsite, stay curled up with your partner after sunset while you wait for the stars. During a forty-minute charging stop, watch two cartoons with the kids or catch up on that movie you and your friends have talked about for ages. When the car is parked and the big display lights up, an ordinary wait becomes time worth remembering.

MANAGE YOUR PLAYLISTS
- Add as many playlist URLs as you need, by link or by scanning a QR code
- Refresh, rename, or remove any of them
- Filter by the groups in your playlist
- Mark favourites for quick access
- Import video files from your device and play them offline

MINI PLAYER
Keep playing while you browse the rest of your list. No need to back out and start over.

PRIVACY
Everything you add stays on your iPhone. No account needed.

CarTV is a player only. It does not provide, host, bundle, or recommend any content. You supply your own playlists and servers and are responsible for having the right to use them.

apps.name: DuckTV IPTV & M3U Player
apps.description:
DuckTV is a player. It does not provide, sell, or host any TV channels, streams, or IPTV subscriptions, and it comes with no content of any kind. There is nothing to watch until you sign in with an account you already have from a provider you already pay. You bring the account; DuckTV brings the interface.

If you already have an Xtream Codes or M3U login from your provider, type the server address, your username and your password, and DuckTV turns that line into a proper TV app on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad.

WHAT DUCKTV IS NOT
• Not a channel provider. No channels, no playlists, no streams are bundled.
• Not a subscription service for television. There is no signup, no provider directory, and no way to buy TV inside the app.
• Not tied to any one company. Any standards-compliant Xtream Codes panel works.

WHAT YOU GET

Live TV that behaves like television
One playback engine, so changing channel is instant instead of a reload. Slide-in channel and category lists, a now/next info bar, favourites, recent channels, and a full time-grid guide with a live now-line when your provider sends EPG data. Prefer a better guide than your panel ships? Point DuckTV at your own XMLTV URL instead.

Movies and Series
Your provider's on-demand catalogue in a poster grid with categories, sorting and search. Playback remembers where you stopped, and picks the next episode up automatically.

Search
One field across live channels, movies and series.

Sports
Live scores, schedules and standings for NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college football and basketball, major soccer competitions and Formula 1 — pulled from public sports data, not from your provider. A spoiler shield hides scores until you ask for them. If you play Yahoo Fantasy, you can connect your Yahoo account (an integration Yahoo has approved) to see your team, your matchup and your players alongside the game.

Multiview
Watch several channels at once in a grid on Apple TV, with audio following the tile you pick.

DVR
Record live TV to the device and play it back from the DVR tab.

Parental controls
A PIN that hides categories you choose, and hides adult categories across Live TV, Movies and Series until the PIN is entered. Because the channels come from your provider and not from us, DuckTV cannot know or filter what is on them — these controls, and your provider's own account settings, are how you decide what is reachable on your device.

A player that actually plays things
DuckTV uses VLC (libVLC) as well as Apple's own engine, so MPEG-TS, HEVC and MKV streams that AVPlayer refuses simply play. Buffer size, hardware decoding and stream format are yours to tune, and an optional stats overlay shows bitrate, resolution and frame rate while you watch.

Built for the remote and for the phone
The Apple TV app is built around the focus engine and the Siri Remote. The iPhone and iPad app is a real touch app — not a stretched TV layout — with Picture in Picture for on-demand playback and background audio.

PRIVACY
Your server address, username and password are stored on your device in the keychain and sent only to your provider. They are never sent to us. There are no ads, no ad identifiers and no third-party tracking SDKs. Anonymous diagnostics can be switched off entirely in Settings → Privacy. Yahoo Fantasy and DuckTrack only do anything if you connect them yourself.

ONE MORE TIME, BECAUSE IT MATTERS
DuckTV has no relationship with any IPTV provider and does not recommend, endorse or resell one. What you watch, and whether you have the right to watch it, is between you and whoever you get your line from. Use DuckTV only with content you are authorised to access.

Requires an Apple TV, iPhone or iPad running tvOS/iOS 17 or later, an internet connection, and your own Xtream Codes or M3U account from a provider.

Questions, or something not working? help@duckingstats.com

A big update: a new side rail that gives landscape screens their full height back, films that no longer stall at 17 seconds, subtitles and soundtracks that now play where they did not, and your favourites and Continue Watching kept safe when a playlist refreshes.

NEW
• Side rail in landscape. Turn your iPhone or iPad on its side and a playlist's tools fold into a slim rail of icons down the left - back, Search, Live, Radio, Films, Series, More and Settings - so channels and posters get the whole height of the screen. Tap an icon to use it, or press and hold the rail to see its labels. It works in every layout: Showcase, Grid and List.
• Prefer the old bar across the top? Settings › Display › Landscape navigation lets you choose between the side rail and the top bar. Held upright, the bar is always on top.
• Search from the rail opens a full search page, with your recent searches under the box.
• Screen edge margin. If a case or the rounded corners of your screen hide something, Settings › Display › Screen edge margin keeps up to 5% clear round the edges. It starts at 0%, using the whole screen.
• A new loading animation throughout the app.

PLAYBACK
• Films that stopped to buffer at about 17 seconds now play through. Some films are encrypted in a way the player on iPhone and iPad could not unlock; the app now prepares the key itself before playing. This also covers films whose soundtracks come as separate streams.
• Subtitles that were listed in the menu but never appeared now show. Some providers link their subtitle tracks to the film the wrong way, and the player could not connect the two. The app now repairs the list before playing, whatever names the provider uses.
• Films that played silently for the same reason now play with their sound.
• The audio language you pick is remembered for each channel.
• Subtitles on DASH streams keep better time with the picture.

SUBTITLES
• No more repeated entries in the subtitle list.
• English subtitles labelled "Bahasa English" are no longer shown as Malay.
• Fixed a case where no subtitle came on even though one was chosen.
• Language names are now the same in every menu, whichever player is used.

FIXED
• Favourites and Continue Watching could disappear after a playlist refreshed - when a provider changed its links, listed the same title twice, or briefly answered with an empty list. Your favourites, watch history and resume points now follow each title, an empty answer from a provider no longer wipes your list, and entries that went missing in earlier versions come back by themselves the next time the playlist loads.
• Parental locks, per-channel audio and subtitle choices and programme reminders now follow a channel when its link changes, too.
• On an iPhone held sideways some windows were taller than the screen, and their last option could not be tapped - most noticeably List in the Layout window, the VOD option in Arrange, and the sort options. Every one of these windows now scrolls.
• Windows with a text box no longer push their buttons out of reach while the keyboard is up.
• "See all", More categories and search inside a Showcase always show a grid.

ALSO
• Playlists from premium providers open on the Showcase pages the provider has chosen.
• Problem reports now include picture and sound timing details, so out-of-sync playback can be traced.

Your watch progress syncs automatically to the cloud across all your devices. Start a movie on iPhone and pick it up on Apple TV, or the other way around. The next episode plays automatically — binge without interruptions.

Download movies and individual episodes to watch without a connection. On a plane, on the subway, off the grid. The app detects when you're offline and automatically switches to offline mode with all your downloaded content.

Organize your favorites with custom tags. Hide categories you don't care about. Reorder everything the way you like. Protect content with PIN-based parental controls. Choose from over 20 avatars for each profile and manage up to 5 playlists with a Premium Plus subscription.

Incognito mode. Manual engine selection for VOD and live separately. Configurable network buffer. Custom HTTP user agent. Adjustable content and EPG cache.

apps.name: SafeIPTV - Secure IPTV Player
apps.description:
Your streams. Your privacy. No ads.

Want to enjoy your channels, movies, and series without ad banners, without tracking, and without an app quietly logging everything in the background? Then SafeIPTV is the player for you: built natively for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV, connected directly to your own IPTV provider, and designed so your data stays with you.

PRIVACY WITHOUT COMPROMISE

• No data collection: no tracking, no analytics, no user profiles. We don't run any server that stores your catalog, history, or usage data. What's never collected can never fall into the wrong hands.
• No account needed: no sign-up, no email address, no tracking ID.
• Everything stays local: SafeIPTV keeps your favorites, history, playback progress, and settings on your device only, never with us.
• Passwords locked down: encrypted in the iOS, macOS, and tvOS Keychain, tied to your device, and never stored in plain text. A pasted playlist, including its stream addresses, stays on your device only.
• No middleman: SafeIPTV connects directly to your provider. No proxy, no detour through our servers, and no storing of your device's MAC address.
• You're in control: clear your history anytime. When you remove an account, SafeIPTV also deletes its password, pasted playlist, catalog, favorites, and history from your device.

That's why our App Privacy label reads: Data Not Collected. Developed in Germany, under EU data protection law.

AD-FREE, UNDISTURBED VIEWING

• Truly ad-free: no banners, no pop-ups, no commercials before your stream. SafeIPTV never inserts ads anywhere, not in the interface and not in the player.
• No hidden costs: no subscription, no premium tier. After a 7-day free trial, a single in-app purchase unlocks every feature for good.
• No distractions: no push notifications, no ad SDKs running in the background. Just you and your shows.

TRY FIRST. BUY ONCE. FOUR DEVICES.

Try SafeIPTV with your own provider for 7 days. The trial simply ends; you're never charged automatically. Like it? Unlock the full version once and use it on iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. On the big screen, you control everything from the couch with the Siri Remote, and on the Mac with a keyboard and mouse. And with Apple's Family Sharing, your family can use the full version too, without buying it again.

MORE FEATURES

• Quick setup: enter your server URL, username, and password, or simply paste your provider's M3U link. On iPhone, iPad, and Mac you can also create your own playlist by pasting M3U entries directly. The app checks them right away and points out lines with errors.
• Live TV, movies, and series in a clean catalog. You search the current category or the whole catalog, sort by name, date, or rating, and save favorites for titles and entire categories. Everything stays on your device.
• Pick up right where you left off, plus “Recently Watched” and “Recently Added”
• Program guide (EPG) with live preview and a time offset for each account
• Choose the audio track, subtitles, and aspect ratio right in the player
• Manage multiple IPTV accounts and switch between them quickly
• Playback built on VLC, with advanced settings for power users: buffering, hardware decoding, and automatic reconnection when a live stream stalls

GOOD TO KNOW

SafeIPTV is a player only and does not include any playlists, channels, movies, series, or other content. The purchase price covers the software only, not IPTV content or a provider subscription. You need your own lawful access from a provider that supports Xtream Codes or M3U playlists. We are not a broadcaster and do not provide any sources.

Support: support@safe-iptv.de
Website: https://safe-iptv.de/en/
Legal: https://safe-iptv.de/legal/?lang=en

apps.name: Spectati: IPTV & Plex Player
apps.description:
Plex, Jellyfin and your IPTV playlist in one app. Spectati puts your media servers and your live channels in one library on Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your XMLTV data becomes a full guide, and files reach your display and your receiver without re-encoding.

ONE LIBRARY
Connect Plex, Jellyfin, IPTV playlists, SMB shares and Emby at the same time. A film that sits on two servers shows up once, and Spectati plays the better copy, judged by resolution, codec, HDR and audio. Search covers titles, episodes and live channels from every source. Spectati writes your progress back to the server, so you can stop on one device and pick up on another.

LIVE TV WITH A REAL GUIDE
Paste an M3U, M3U8 or JSON playlist, or connect an Xtream provider. You get now and next, categories and a timeline you can scroll. SD, HD and 4K feeds of the same channel group under one entry. Hide, rename, sort and pin channels, and your changes survive a playlist refresh. On Apple TV you can zap up and down without leaving the player. On iPad, Mac and Apple TV, Multiview plays up to four channels at once.

SPORTS
Follow leagues and teams in football, basketball, ice hockey, tennis, motorsport and more, and Spectati finds their matches in your IPTV source's XMLTV guide. Subscribers get kickoff reminders, Watch from Kickoff on catch-up channels and Matchday Multiview.

PLAYBACK
High-bitrate 4K remuxes direct-play, with no server transcoding. Dolby Vision, HDR10+, HDR10 and HLG go to the display. Dolby Atmos, TrueHD, E-AC-3 and DTS go to the receiver. Adjust audio delay and subtitle timing. Subtitles come from OpenSubtitles, live channels carry DVB teletext, and IntroDB skips the intro.

NATIVE ON EVERY APPLE DEVICE
Written in Swift for tvOS, iOS, iPadOS and macOS 26 or later. Spectati follows the current Apple TV user, so everyone in the house keeps their own watch history. Families get a PIN lock and age-rating caps.

FREE TO USE
No ads and no card. Connect up to two sources and you get live TV with the full guide, 4K remuxes in SDR and channel curation. Four Blender open movies on Home let you try the player before you connect anything.

FEATURES
• Continue Watching, watch history, watchlist and favorites
• Like or Not For Me on anything, and Home rows that follow your ratings
• Chapters, playback speed and audio modes
• AirPlay and Picture in Picture

BRING YOUR OWN CONTENT
Spectati is a player and organizer. It does not provide media, channels, IPTV subscriptions, playlists, accounts, metadata, subtitles, storage or internet access. Connect your own supported providers and only stream content you're authorized to access.

SUBSCRIPTION
Browsing, live TV and playback need no account and no subscription, with up to two sources connected. The subscription is optional. It lifts the two-source limit and adds full quality playback with HDR and surround sound, offline downloads, IPTV catch-up and on-demand, bulk channel tools, program reminders, iCloud sync of your sources, lists and watch state, Multiview, Sports, automatic subtitles and SIMKL and Trakt watch-history sync. It renews automatically and is billed through the App Store, with a free trial when available. You can also choose a one-time lifetime purchase. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Mac, and Family Sharing is supported. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Flip channels instantly while watching — no need to exit playback and go back to the list. Fast, seamless channel switching, just like a real remote.

- XTREAM CODES LOGIN
Connect instantly — enter your server URL, username, and password. No complicated setup.

- M3U PLAYLIST SUPPORT
Works as a flexible M3U Player: M3U URL, remote playlist, or local file. Channels are auto-organized in one place.

- EPG TV GUIDE
See what's playing now and what's coming up next with a built-in EPG guide — plan your viewing at a glance.

- CATCH-UP TV
Missed a show? Watch past programs with catch-up support — never lose your favorite content to a missed schedule.

- PICTURE-IN-PICTURE (PiP)
Keep watching in a floating window while you browse other apps. Multitask without missing a moment of your show.

- CONTINUE WATCHING & FAVORITES
Pick up movies and series right where you left off. Save your favorite channels and VOD for one-tap access.

- MULTIPLE THEMES
Personalize your experience with multiple app themes — switch the look and feel to match your style.

- PARENTAL CONTROL
Lock adult categories and specific channels behind a PIN to keep viewing safe for the whole family.

- LIVE TV, MOVIES, SERIES & VOD
Stream Live TV, Movies, TV Series, VOD, Sports, News, and Entertainment — auto-categorized for easy browsing.

- QUICK PLAY — NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Paste any direct stream link and start watching instantly — no account, no setup, nothing to configure.

MORE FEATURES
- Dual playback engines for maximum format support
- Fast channel loading and stable HD / 4K playback
- Modern, responsive UI with multiple themes
- Full playlist management

iOS 16.0 or later. Works on iPhone and iPad.

apps.releaseNotes:
- Complete redesign of the download manager for improved reliability and stability.
- Ability to pause and resume downloads at any time.
- Added localized system notifications for download progress and status.
- Added an option to configure episode autoplay (never, until the end of the current season, or through all remaining seasons).
- Replaced all icons with LucideIcons.
- Translated in-app purchase error messages and improved recovery from subscription service connection failures.
- Removed multi-screen protection for external player playback.
- Profile and settings icons are now animated.
- Playback in an external player on iOS and macOS: Infuse and VLC.
- "Open in …" in a movie or episode menu to pick the external player.
- The playback position is sent to the external player to resume, and the progress is saved on return when the player reports it.
- Movie and episode menu: pick another version, download, copy the stream link, mark as watched or delete the progress.
- Animated rating stars.
- Playback statistics dialog in the video player.
- The favorite button is now filled.
- New replay playing system when the server allows it.
- Kept downloads active on mobile networks and during long transfers.
- Resolved download redirects and properly sent the configured User-Agent.
- Restored downloaded file paths when the application sandbox moves.
- Automatically restarted interrupted downloads when reopening the application.
- Limited to a single active download at a time for optimal performance and network stability.
- The Apple video player (iOS / macOS) now uses the custom User-Agent.
- The Apple video player (iOS / macOS) no longer automatically selects subtitle tracks on start.
- The saved volume is now applied when the video player opens.
- The player selection dialog now focuses only one option.
- The player no longer tries to advance when there is no next item.
- Reworked application startup flow with clearer error messages and a functioning retry button.
- Improved network connectivity detection with a fallback probe and smooth offline mode transition.
- Startup loading messages are now localized.
- Fixed subscription purchase date displaying the expiration date instead.
- Improved authentication error handling with clearer feedback.
- Sending a password recovery email now restores the authentication screen correctly.
- The login QR code no longer changes while it is displayed.
- Fixed the progress displayed while loading M3U playlists and reset it after an error.
- Improved validation for playlist connection inputs.
- Fixed the progress displayed for the current EPG program.
- XMLTV EPG guides without timezones and unpadded base64 texts are now loaded without errors.
- The category selector now stays synchronized when opening channels from favorites.
- The live-channel explorer no longer tries to open a missing category.
- TMDB search now handles special characters correctly.
- Fixed series credits and metadata on mobile.
- Missing or invalid episode and season dates no longer cause display errors.
- Canceling the virtual keyboard no longer clears the input field.
- The virtual keyboard toggle now displays the correct letters or numbers mode.
- Fixed slider steps on TV devices when the minimum value is not zero.
- The proposed update now matches the latest available version.
- An unsupported system language no longer causes an application error.
- Favorite actions no longer cause errors while subscription data is loading.
- The download button no longer causes an error while the active source is loading.
- The external player no longer causes an error while connectivity or subscription data is loading.
- Certain Xtream sources could not be played when the "duration" field was malformed.
- The progress now updates automatically when leaving VLC to return to the app.
- Fixed an overflow in the movie and episode menus.
- Faster loading of continue watching for series.
